name: rome-basilica
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art background atlas for a side-scrolling Flappy Pope game.
Create ONE SQUARE IMAGE, exactly 1024x1024, containing TWO landscape panels stacked vertically with the split at EXACTLY y=512 (50%). Each panel is exactly 1024x512. No border, no gutter, no labels. TOP PANEL = bright daylight. BOTTOM PANEL = moonlit night. Both panels show the IDENTICAL scene and camera framing, matching every building, mountain, tree and shoreline position; only illumination, sky and window light change.
Crisp authentic 8-bit / 16-bit pixel art: deliberate square pixels, stepped contours, clean limited palette, subtle pixel dithering, no anti-aliasing, no smooth blur, no smooth gradients. Each landscape panel must have its upper 60% as spacious uncluttered sky for gameplay, and buildings/terrain in the lower 40%; architecture is intentionally small in the scene. Main cross-topped Catholic church centered around 55% of image width, so a narrow central mobile crop keeps the church visible.
Daylight: bright blue sky, small sparse blocky white clouds, cream limestone, lush greens. Night: deep indigo sky, sparse tiny square stars and small moon, luminous amber church windows/stained glass, visibly readable dark architecture and landscape.
No people, characters, sacred figures, saints, statues, Eucharist, birds, text, words, watermarks, UI, pipes, or foreground obstacles. Catholic identity through prominent architectural crosses only.
Scene: Grand Roman domed Catholic basilica with lantern and clear cross on top, a sunlit stone plaza, distant classical Roman rooftops and umbrella pine trees. The grand dome must fit the lower 40% of each panorama.
